Print a compositional variable

Source: R/declare_composition.R
print.compD.Rd

Prints the parts, the closure (with its unit label, when one was declared) and the number of observations of a declare_composition() object, with a line each for imputed zeroes and flagged outliers when there are any. summary.compD() gives the descriptive tables and plot.compD() the figures.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'compD'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A compD object from declare_composition().

...

Unused; present for S3 consistency.

Value

x, invisibly.

See also

summary.compD() for the descriptive tables and the fuller provenance report; plot.compD() for the figures.

Examples

declare_composition(timeuse, c("MVPA", "LPA", "SB", "SPT"), closure = 1440)
#> <compD> compositional variable
#>   Parts: MVPA, LPA, SB, SPT
#>   Closure: 1440
#>   Observations: 300
